item.title: Experience
item.description:
Experience

Amazon

Software Engineer | 2021-05 - present

  • Led the design and development of Negotiation Data Service (NDS), a suite of APIs powering financial metrics for contract negotiations with third-party vendors. Improved P99 latency by 97% over legacy systems using AWS ECS, Aurora, Glue, and S3.

  • Built a scalable data ingestion and processing pipeline supporting 100GB+ weekly loads, including cross-region S3 access and a standardized Spark/Glue framework that reduced job development time from 7 to 2 days.

item.title: Projects
item.description:
Projects

For all up-to-date projects logs see the blog

  • VFD for Induction Motors: A variable frequency drive (VFD) designed and built for mid-power consumer induction motors. Capable of controlling speed and torque of single and three-phase motors.

  • FOC Driver for PMSMs: A motor driver for permanent magnet AC motors. It implements an FOC algorithm on an STM32 to control torque, speed, and position of the motor.

  • ARManda: A 4 DOF robotic manipulator from scratch. It uses NEMA stepper motors for the actuators, described in another project, and runs on ROS (RViz and MoveIt).
